mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% compresses equity discount rates through reduced risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in real GDP and housing starts indicates robust consumer demand, reducing equity risk premia and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when either GDPC1 or HOUST is below 3-mo MA, and 20-day returns are not significantly positive in the joint expansion period (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate above 4.0% with rising momentum signals economic distress, increasing equity risk premia and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.0% and UNRATE rising > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% and rising, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 0.5% monthly indicates manufacturing strength, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in high-INDPRO periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% annualized signals persistent inflation, prompting rate hikes that increase equity discount rates and cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1400 thousand units signal strong residential construction, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1400.0, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll growth above 0.5% monthly and unemployment rate below 3.8% signals labor market tightness, increasing consumer spending and equity valuations for positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when either PAYEMS growth is not > 0.5% MoM or UNRATE is not < 3.8%, and 60-day returns are not significantly positive in the joint condition (t-test p > 0.05).
